claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Loreclezole is a GABA-A receptor positive allosteric modulator with no known cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines, with any weak effects reflecting non-specific physicochemical or GABA-receptor-independent modulation rather than a genuine antiproliferative mechanism.
